title: Hinomori Shiho — Imagining That Smile〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Where could Hona and Ichi be?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They said they're sitting on a bench in the park... Oh, there they are.
se_run_women_001_1
se_run_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry about the wait.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, that's okay since it gave me a chance to bandage up my hand.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh yeah, we got plenty of drinks.
Coffee, orange juice and...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks♪
Then, let's show them what we got!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Right. Starting with...
Your apple pie, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you so much!
Oh, that's really cute! It's in the shape of an apple!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Next...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Here you are, Ichika...
Your yakisoba bun...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks... Wait, huh?
Is this from a convenience store...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry, we asked the bakery if they had any, but they said they didn't...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But you really seemed to be craving one, so we quickly looked for a convenience store that carried them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, is that why you two took a while...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's one reason...
The first store we found was all sold out, which didn't help.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks for going through the trouble of finding this for me. I really appreciate it, you two.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, also! That bakery let us try a bunch of different samples♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You basically made a whole meal out of them, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I didn't have that many!
I wanted to try them all, but I made sure to stop myself.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Which was the right thing to do.
That clerk had their eye on you the whole time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're kidding, right?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What...?! Shiho, you meanie!

rows.Speaker: Honami & Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, did they have any you liked?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup♪ I actually picked out my top three and decided to get them all!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
In third place!
These Florentine biscuits.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, that's not bread...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you. I knew one of you would say that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
B-But they're so yummy!
And they make for such a great dessert!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Anyway, in second place!
This Danish cinnamon roll!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho also tried the sample for this one!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, it was really good. On top of the cinnamon smelling nice, the dough was really fluffy.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's split this one between the four of us later.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay.
Hehe. I can't wait to try it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anyway, Saki, you still have one left to present. What came in first place?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh. Alright, get ready!
My number one favorite is...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Drum roooll...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ta-daa! This Kouign... Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ko-Koui... No, Kouign...
Kouign-gamann!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Did you mean Kouign-amann?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, those are really good.
I like how they're crispy on the outside and fluffy on the inside.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Exactly, Ichi!
Let's split this one too♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
We'll be sharing quite a lot.
Will you two have enough for yourselves?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We should. I got myself a panini, and Saki bought a melon bun.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's start.
I'm actually pretty hungry.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. We did do some shop hopping♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now then...

rows.Speaker: Saki, Ichika, Shiho & Honami
rows.Line:
Let's eat!
Let's eat.
